/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git add CHANGELOG.md README.md SOURCE_PROVENANCE.json VERSION backend/app/platform/settings.py backend/pyproject.toml backend/tests/test_company_qualification_contract.py backend/tests/test_qualification_bootstrap.py backend/tests/test_release_safety.py backend/tests/test_security.py contracts/openapi.json docs/API_COMPATIBILITY.md docs/COMPANY_QUALIFICATION.md docs/DELIVERY_VERIFICATION.md docs/DEPLOYMENT.md docs/MAC_QUICKSTART.md docs/MASTER_DESIGN.md docs/RELEASE_STATUS.md docs/TESTING.md docs/requirements-status.json docs/v1-completion-status.json frontend/package-lock.json frontend/package.json frontend/src/platform/ui/OverlayShell.tsx frontend/src/theme/application.css frontend/stories/Engineering.stories.tsx frontend/tests/e2e/uiqa.spec.ts frontend/tests/e2e/ui-state-matrix.json scripts/bind_release_evidence.py scripts/check_ui_state_matrix.py scripts/e2e_runner.py scripts/generate_release_identity.py scripts/release_evidence.py scripts/verify.py tests/test_release_evidence.py tests/test_ui_state_matrix.py && rtk git diff --cached --check && rtk git status --short | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sed -n '1p' checkpoints/react-fastapi-base-chg34-rc12.zip.sha256 && rtk backend/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q backend/tests/test_company_qualification_contract.py backend/tests/test_qualification_bootstrap.py backend/tests/test_release_safety.py backend/tests/test_security.py"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk backend/.venv/bin/python scripts/check_ui_state_matrix.py --results evidence/current/uiqa/ui-state-matrix-results.json && rtk jq '[.results[]|{state_id,status,dimensions:(.exercised_dimensions|length),artifacts:(.artifact_locators|length)}]' evidence/current/uiqa/ui-state-matrix-results.json && rtk jq '{source_commit,matrix_sha256,overall_status,results:[.results[]|{state_id,status,exercised_dimensions}]}' evidence/current/uiqa/ui-state-matrix-results.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq '{state_classes:.material_state_classes,dimensions:.required_dimensions,row_counts:(.rows|group_by(.material_state_class)|map({class:.[0].material_state_class,count:length})),applicable:(.rows|map(select(.applicability==\"applicable\"))|length)}' frontend/tests/e2e/ui-state-matrix.json && rtk jq '{overall_status,source_commit,matrix_sha256,dimension_counts:(.results|map(.exercised_dimensions[])|group_by(.)|map({dimension:.[0],count:length})),focus:(.results[]|select(.state_id==\"chg34-dialog-focus-recovery\")),reflow:(.results[]|select(.state_id==\"chg34-reflow-320-css-px\")),motion:(.results[]|select(.state_id==\"chg34-reduced-motion\")),forced:(.results[]|select(.state_id==\"chg34-forced-colors\"))}' evidence/current/uiqa/ui-state-matrix-results.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq '.results[]|select(.state_id==\"chg34-dialog-focus-recovery\" or .state_id==\"chg34-reflow-320-css-px\" or .state_id==\"chg34-reduced-motion\" or .state_id==\"chg34-forced-colors\")' evidence/current/uiqa/ui-state-matrix-results.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk backend/.venv/bin/python -c \"import hashlib,json,pathlib; root=pathlib.Path('.'); manifest=json.loads((root/'evidence/current/release/rc12-manifest.json').read_text()); binding=json.loads((root/'evidence/current/release/rc12-evidence-binding.json').read_text()); print({'manifest_evidence_commit':manifest['evidence_commit'],'binding_evidence_commit':binding['evidence_commit'],'manifest_sha_matches':hashlib.sha256((root/'evidence/current/release/rc12-manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==binding['manifest']['sha256'],'uiqa_sha_matches':manifest['uiqa_matrix']['sha256']==hashlib.sha256((root/manifest['uiqa_matrix']['locator']).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source_bound':manifest['verified_source_commit']=='32d1cc0d3bfb6bc76413103566162c304f2843f1','base_bound':manifest['target_base_sha']=='1de9cfae29450990d201785f35992c72ff0d0684','binding_status':binding['binding_status']})\" && rtk jq '{identity_type,candidate_version,verified_source_commit,source_digest,code_ready,production_ready,release_status}' deploy/rc12-release-identity.json && rtk git status --short && rtk git log -4 --oneline --decorate && rtk git merge-base --is-ancestor 1de9cfae29450990d201785f35992c72ff0d0684 HEAD"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git restore --source=e548751809b3f0c6e0a5cba73362eea6fcc568a2 -- evidence/current/full-stack/api-compatibility.json evidence/current/full-stack/backend-junit.shard-1.xml evidence/current/full-stack/backend-junit.shard-2.xml evidence/current/full-stack/backend-junit.shard-3.xml evidence/current/full-stack/backend-junit.shard-4.xml evidence/current/full-stack/backend-junit.xml evidence/current/full-stack/backend-tests.log evidence/current/full-stack/checkpoint-manifest.log evidence/current/full-stack/native-lab/browser-interactions.log evidence/current/full-stack/native-lab/browser-junit.xml evidence/current/full-stack/native-lab/pure-model-tests.log evidence/current/full-stack/native-lab/static-http-server.log evidence/current/full-stack/native-lab/verification.json evidence/current/full-stack/performance-owned-algorithms.log evidence/current/full-stack/performance-stress.log evidence/current/full-stack/security-source.log evidence/current/full-stack/static-server.log evidence/current/full-stack/tooling-tests.log evidence/current/full-stack/typescript-syntax-and-pure-client.log evidence/current/performance/stress.json && rtk git status --porcelain && rtk backend/.venv/bin/python scripts/check_ui_state_matrix.py --results evidence/current/uiqa/ui-state-matrix-results.json'
